raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends amount corrections inside the daily delivery by repeating the txn_id with an incremented record_version. silver_transactions keeps both versions, which produces 27 duplicate txn_ids (exactly the 27 record_version=2 rows: 4841 rows vs 4814 distinct ids) and double counts them in gold. The fix keeps only the latest version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, so a later correction also governs status.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
